drhp.business: The Company provides safe transportation of bulk liquids (hazardous and food-grade) using ISO tanks and flexi-bags, shipping services for dry cargo through 20'GP and 40'HC containers, and global freight forwarding by sea, air, and multimodal routes. It offers customised logistics and supply chain management solutions along with tech-enabled platforms for real-time cargo tracking and operations, serving a diversified client base of over 1,000 customers across India and key international markets.
drhp.expansion: The Company's expansion activity during FY2025-26 was contractual and organisational rather than physical-asset capex: it secured contracts for the deployment of tankers in domestic transportation and storage activities in both India and Thailand, and reinforced relationships with leasing partners to enhance operational flexibility and market position. It is implementing a company-wide ERP system (go-live targeted November 2026) and AI initiatives for route optimisation, inventory management and profitability across all company verticals. Subsequent to year-end, the Board approved increasing its stake in the Malaysian Subsidiary from 55.14% to 70.48% to deepen regional presence and support the subsidiary's plans to expand its business streams.

end_markets.title: End Markets (RHP)
end_markets.body:
- India
- UAE
- Malaysia
- China
- Thailand
- United States
- Europe

demand_drivers.title: Mdna (RHP)
demand_drivers.body:
- Long-haul routes to the United States and Europe came under pressure from the ongoing conflict in Ukraine and instability in the Red Sea, estimated to have impacted consolidated revenue by approximately 15% during the year.
- In response, the Company increased longer-term contracts for domestic deployment in India and Thailand and converted a portion of operating lease assets to finance leases, which were the primary drivers of improvement in EBITDA and EBIT margins.
- The Company operates primarily in a single business segment (logistics and shipping services); given the integrated nature of operations, separate segmental reporting is not applicable.
- Opportunities cited: expansion of global trade and increased outsourcing of logistics services, rising demand for integrated technology-driven shipping and logistics solutions, government push towards infrastructure development and multimodal connectivity, growth in e-commerce/pharmaceuticals/manufacturing sectors, increase in manufacturing activity in Asia apart from China, increasing preference for environmentally responsible logistics partners.
- Threats cited: global supply chain disruptions from geopolitical factors, volatility in fuel prices and foreign exchange rates, competitive pricing from unorganized and regional logistics players, increased presence of large European players in the Asian market, rising compliance requirements in hazardous material handling and shipping, technological disruptions and cyber risks.

capex_expansion.title: Expansion (RHP)
capex_expansion.body: The Company's expansion activity during FY2025-26 was contractual and organisational rather than physical-asset capex: it secured contracts for the deployment of tankers in domestic transportation and storage activities in both India and Thailand, and reinforced relationships with leasing partners to enhance operational flexibility and market position. It is implementing a company-wide ERP system (go-live targeted November 2026) and AI initiatives for route optimisation, inventory management and profitability across all company verticals. Subsequent to year-end, the Board approved increasing its stake in the Malaysian Subsidiary from 55.14% to 70.48% to deepen regional presence and support the subsidiary's plans to expand its business streams.

moat.title: Strengths (RHP)
moat.body:
- customer lock-in: Strong customer relationships and high client retention — evidence: services a diversified client base of over 1,000 customers, with a high retention rate driven by customer-centric solutions
- distribution: Presence in international markets including UAE, Malaysia, China, and Thailand — evidence: with a presence across India and key international markets, the Company offers safe transportation of bulk liquids and shipping services
- technology: Integrated digital platforms for logistics visibility and operational efficiency — evidence: tech-enabled platforms for real-time cargo tracking and operations

risks.title: Risks (RHP)
risks.body:
- Economic slowdowns or trade restrictions may impact volumes.
- Dependence on international shipping routes and third-party vendors.
- Compliance with evolving maritime, customs, and environmental laws.
- Exposure to delays or defaults in customer payments.
- The ongoing conflict in Ukraine and disruptions in the Red Sea adversely affected long-haul shipping routes to the United States and Europe, estimated to have impacted consolidated revenue by approximately 15% during the year.
- Cited as a threat under Opportunities and Threats in the MD&A.
- Competitive pricing from unorganized and regional logistics players, and increased presence of large European players in the Asian market.
- Cited as a threat given the Company's hazardous-cargo logistics business.
- Cited as a threat under Opportunities and Threats in the MD&A.

strategy.title: Strategies (RHP)
strategy.body:
- Reduce operational footprint on long-haul Western routes and consolidate focus within Asian markets, where the Company has the strongest control, deepest relationships, and clearest line of sight to profitable growth.
- Prioritise asset utilisation and margins over volume by increasing longer-term contracts for domestic deployment in India and Thailand, and by converting a portion of operating lease assets to finance leases.
- Complete the company-wide technology transition (ERP rollout and AI-enabled operational efficiency) in FY2026-27.
- Deepen presence in the Malaysian Subsidiary and support its next phase of growth, including a longer-term aspiration to explore a Main Board listing.
- Divest the stake in King Star Freight Private Limited to sharpen the portfolio and free up capital for higher-conviction opportunities within core markets.
- Strengthen senior leadership bench and organisational capability for the next phase of growth.
